The anchor carries title='Quem Somos – doação', which is the destination page's own title ('Quem Somos - doação'); H33 (supplementing link text with the title attribute) is a sufficient technique for 2.4.4, and its test (title plus link text describes the purpose) passes because naming the destination document suffices. The card's heading 'Doação de sangue e medula' and the line 'Seu gesto solidário salva vidas!' sit directly above the button in the same card. So 'nothing around it' tells where it goes is not true. Weak link text, but not a 2.4.4 failure; it would fail 2.4.9 (AAA). Rampa had the title attribute and the heading in its context.
